title: Twin Cast: Faith and Intelligence Are Not Opposites
description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, Douglas Ell challenges a common belief — that faith and intelligence don’t go together.

He explains how many people grow up thinking science and God are in conflict, when in reality, science is simply a tool used to understand the world around us.

It’s not a religion — it’s a method.

This perspective opens the door to a deeper conversation about how logic, reasoning, and belief can actually work together, not against each other.

If you’ve ever questioned how faith fits with knowledge and understanding, this is a conversation worth listening to.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, real-life perspectives, and meaningful discussions.
